$comment: Reviewed exceptions for npm run check:dependencies. Every entry needs an advisory ID, a stated reason, reviewedAt, a reviewBy date and an optional tracking issue. An expired entry, a stale entry that no longer matches an advisory, or an entry without a reason fails the gate. Read docs/security-policy.md before changing this file. The list is reviewed quarterly; reviewBy is the hard expiry.

entries.reason: glib 0.18.5 has an unsoundness advisory fixed in 0.20.0. Tauri's GTK 0.18 generation pins glib 0.18.x and the app never calls the affected VariantStrIter impls directly. Linux-only; the Windows and macOS artifacts do not link it. Revisit with the Tauri/gtk-rs 0.20 upgrade.

Build-time only through glib-macros and gtk. The crate is unmaintained but has no known vulnerability and is not linked into the shipped binary. Removing it needs the same Tauri/gtk-rs upgrade as glib.

Reached only through tauri-plugin-single-instance -> zbus 5 on Linux. Unmaintained but no known vulnerability; the single-instance channel is local and advisory. Removing it needs a Tauri/zbus upgrade.
